landing.kicker: Anime Graph · the list that works for you
landing.title: Don't just track anime and manga. Understand what you love.
landing.body: Bring over your MAL or AniList library, follow each season, and find personal matches based on your ratings — not just popularity.
landing.catalogTitle: Take a look before you sign up
landing.catalogFallback: Anime, manga, current seasons and community rankings are available to browse without an account.
landing.feature1Text: Bring across MAL and AniList statuses, scores and progress. Your old list stays useful.
landing.feature2Text: A fit score built from your own ratings shows which titles may work for you, and why.
landing.feature3Text: Public title pages, seasonal views and rankings make finding a new favourite easier.
landing.closingTitle: Start with the list you already have, or explore first.
landing.closingText: After creating an account, you can begin with a MAL or AniList import.
landing.seo: Personal anime and manga tracker with taste-based discovery.

community.heading: What people are watching and thinking

onboardingCta.headline: Bring your list over — 30 seconds, and we'll tell you who you are as a viewer
onboardingCta.body: A MAL or AniList import carries over every score and status, and the AI writes your taste profile right away. Your old list stays intact.

graph.tour3Text: WASD + Q/E: free flight through your own anime universe. Timeline mode sits in the bottom-right corner.
